purpose: Define explicit isolation of a suspect/degraded service instance from traffic/work while preserving evidence and avoiding accidental global disable.

topics.name: Service Quarantine
topics.purpose: Define explicit isolation of a suspect/degraded service instance from traffic/work while preserving evidence and avoiding accidental global disable.

semantics.target_rule: Quarantine targets exact runtime instance or bounded set.
semantics.data_rule: Quarantine does not automatically delete state/data.
semantics.scope_rule: Quarantine scope cannot expand from one instance by naming similarity.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.

hard_gates.condition: quarantining one service disables all same-name instances

references.purpose: Quarantine may be an incident containment operation.
